rationale: The file contains recognizable HLF transaction entrypoints (Init and Invoke methods). However, no C1–C6 vulnerability patterns exist: there are no time.Now() calls, no goroutines, no map iterations influencing writes, no non-revalidated queries determining write decisions, and no mutable package-level globals. The invoke() function performs cross-chaincode calls via InvokeChaincode, but these are deterministic external calls whose results are used only for arithmetic (sumVal = Aval + Bval) before writing to state—not nondeterministic sources. All ledger writes (PutState) depend only on parsed arguments and deterministic arithmetic.
